historicalNote.text: Isolated conical hill, 4,389 feet high, in the Hunsur of Mysore District, Mysore, On the summit is a temple of Annadani Mallikarjuna, the family god of the Changalva kings. At the foot of the hill is Bettadpur village, a settlement of the Sanketi Brahmans.
